svg.title: Small bases grew fastest. Large ones added most.
svg.desc: Five groups are ranked by their starting public-push counts, not population. Counts are 30, 30, 29, 30 and 30 economies. Growth uses combined group totals; additions use net increases.
svg.metadata: Data: GitHub Innovation Graph (CC0), https://github.com/github/innovationgraph/tree/078fb62ee4395d321bec9f4f06694cca68f6b6cb/data. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain); DataMeet India, CC BY 4.0, adapted. Full linked attribution accompanies each map in the gallery and notes.
